about: Venticinque for three persons. The Turin rulebook of 1787 names it in its list of games (p. 8: «A Venticinque carte in tre persone») but has no chapter on it. Torino [1846], part I, pp. 33-34, gives the discard (the trumps that may be put away), the count in threes, the three deals and the winner of the match (the greater total); Prammatica [1846], pp. 13-14, the line of 26. Dummett 1980, p. 260 (partial scan held), after the rules of 1830 (not held), gives the deal in rounds of 5, 10 and 10 with an a monte by consent, the running total less 26, and the «fuora» play. The general rules of the 1787 book fill the rest: the trionfi, the suits, the Fool, how to answer. Not played by the engine for lack of a format key: the payment of the match and the «fuora» play (FORMAT_OPEN_POINTS point 6). Marks: [D] documented, [R] our reading, [S] sources silent.

dummett1980.cite: M. Dummett, The Game of Tarot, London, Duckworth, 1980; chapter XIII, pp. 258-279 (partial scan held, p. 268 missing)

ri1830.cite: Carlo O..., Regole inalterabili per tutti i giuochi di Tarocco detti di commercio, Torino, 1830 (RI), known only through Dummett 1980

torino1846.cite: L. B., Il giuocatore di tarocchi al tavoliere, part I (Grammatica del giuocatore), Torino, Serra, [1846]

prammatica1846.cite: L. B., Prammatica ossia regole indispensabili per gli amatori di simile passatempo, part II of the same book, Torino, [1846]

count.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «A Venticinque in tre»; Torino 1787, p. 8 gives only the name.

direction.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 35, 37: «gli altri sempre a destra procedendo»: play passes to the right.

first_dealer.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 16: cards are turned up for each side, «se viene prima da questa parte un Trionfo, mischierò io»: the side that first receives a trionfo shuffles and deals first.

cut_by.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 16-17: the player on the dealer's left cuts («di dar a coppare a chi ti siede a sinistra»); if he declines the next on the left, if all decline the dealer deals as the pack lies.

cut_min.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 16: «Una carta sola non si può coppare»: a cut leaves at least two cards in each part.

dealer_rotation.source: [S] Torino [1846], part I, p. 34 does not say who deals next; ours after Torino [1846], part I, p. 18: «si rimette il mazzo a chi vien dopo a destra».

mode.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): each player scores for himself and keeps his own running total.

deck.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): three times 25 cards and the dealer's three more make the whole pack, which is also the 78 points of the count.

trump_order.source: [D] Dummett 1980, pp. 259-260: the Piedmontese order, the Angel XX above the World XXI; Torino 1787, p. 13 gives the same («l'Angelo ... appresso noi prende il Mondo»).

suit_order.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 11-13: in swords and batons the larger number takes the smaller; in cups and coins «la carta di numero inferiore prende quella di numero superiore, eccetto le figure» (the ace takes the two up to the ten); the courts stand above every numeral. [R] The order among the courts, King, Queen, Knight, Jack, is read from their points 5, 4, 3, 2 (pp. 13-14) and from the list of p. 10.

card_points.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 259: Angel, Bagatto, Fool and each King 5, each Queen 4, each Knight 3, each Jack 2; the World has no value; same as Torino 1787, pp. 13-14.

honours.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 259: the honours are the five-point cards, the four Kings, the Angel, Bagatto and the Fool; Torino 1787, p. 34 names the same four kinds.

fool.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «mostrandolo in tavola agli altri due», then kept with his cards.

fool_exchange.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «dare in compenso un'altra cartuccia qualunque, onde chi ha presa … la mano».

fool_exchange_card.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «un'altra cartuccia qualunque».

fool_exchange_to.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «dare in compenso un'altra cartuccia qualunque, onde chi ha presa … la mano».

fool_no_tricks.source: [D] Prammatica [1846], p. 6: «chi non potesse coprirlo, alla fine della mano è obbligato di cederlo».

hand_size.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «con venticinque carte per ciascuno: ne sopravanzano tre», discarded by the dealer.

dealer_extra.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «con venticinque carte per ciascuno: ne sopravanzano tre», discarded by the dealer.

extra_when.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): the dealer takes «the last three cards» of the pack.

packets.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): three rounds, the first of five cards each, the second and the third of ten each. The same 5, 10, 10 is the custom of Bagatt'ultimo, Torino 1787, pp. 91-92.

dead.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): 25 + 25 + 28 is the whole pack of 78.

order.source: [R] Torino [1846], part I, p. 51 (Mitigati for three): «5 a chi ti sta a destra», then left, then the dealer.

phases.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): after each round of the deal the players may throw the deal in if all agree.

consent.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): «a monte» only if all agree; Torino 1787, pp. 29-30: «cambiar le carte ... o affatto rifare la data».

what.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 259: «a monte» is giving up the deal; changing only some cards is not described (FORMAT_OPEN_POINTS point 27).

windows.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): the choice is offered after every round of the deal; the key «deal.packet» is the proposal of FORMAT_OPEN_POINTS point 6 (a window inside a phase).

who.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «con venticinque carte per ciascuno: ne sopravanzano tre», discarded by the dealer.

count.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «con venticinque carte per ciascuno: ne sopravanzano tre», discarded by the dealer.

discard_honours_barred.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «rigorosamente proibito lo scarto degli Onori»; Prammatica [1846], p. 14: «paga partita».

barred.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: «Lo scarto dei Tarocchi è solo permesso quando non se ne hanno in mano più di tre»: no trump is put away, but for the exception that follows. Revision 1 played the other edition, Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after the rules of 1830): no trionfo from XVII up.

allowed_exceptions.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33: trumps are put away only «quando non se ne hanno in mano più di tre»: a dealer who holds three trumps or fewer may put them away, the honours never. [R] The Fool is not counted among the trumps held. With 28 cards this happens in 1.32 % of the deals. In the edition of 1830 (Dummett 1980, p. 260) there is no such exception.

announce.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 259: the discard is announced with «Ho scartato» and is then final; Torino 1787, p. 34 (rule 37): «Chi dirà ho scartato, e poi vorrà ricambiare lo scarto, non potrà più».

first_leader.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 259: the player to the dealer's right leads; Torino 1787, p. 35: «Chi è a destra di chi dà, comincia».

next_leader.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 50: «Chi prende giuoca sempre il primiero».

follow_suit.source: [R] Torino [1846], part I, p. 36: «è rigorosamente proibito il rifiato», said for Partita and the games after it; carried back.

must_trump.source: [R] Torino [1846], part I, p. 36 prints the duty for Partita and the games after it: «si risponderà e prenderà con un Trionfo»; carried back to this game.

must_overtrump.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 49: the book states no duty to beat a trump on the table.

group.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 34: «I punti si contano con tre carte».

count_unit.source: [R] Dummett 1980, p. 260: with threes the whole pack is worth 78 points, as 130 less 52; the value of a card is its points less two thirds, see GAME_FILE_FORMAT 11.12.

trick_multipliers.source: [R] Torino 1787: the count is the one the section names; the book prints no trick multiplier and no war in these games (x2 and x4 are Duello's own).

last_trick_bonus.source: [R] Torino 1787: the book prints no bonus for the last trick (the +5 is Duello's own).

odd_card.source: [S] Torino [1846], part I, p. 34 says only «I punti si contano con tre carte»; ours: a short group.

winner.source: [R] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): in every round each player enters the difference between his points and 26; there is no winner of a single hand, the running total decides (match). The threshold is the line of 26.

target.source: [D] Prammatica [1846], p. 14: the line is twenty-six points («il numero di ventisei punti»).

game_points.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): the hand gives no game point; the match pays by the running totals.

kind.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 34: «La partita si fa in tre scarti»; «Vince chi ha dei tre fatti e guadagnati un maggior numero di punti»: after three deals the greatest total wins. Each player keeps the running total of the differences between his points and 26 (Prammatica [1846], p. 14). Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after the rules of 1830) ends the game sooner, at the first sure positive total of the last round: see left_out, fuora_declaration.

round_target.source: [D] Prammatica [1846], p. 14: the line is twenty-six points («il numero di ventisei punti»).

rounds.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 34: «La partita si fa in tre scarti»; Prammatica [1846], pp. 13-14.

play.value: when «fuora» (running total above 26 after two rounds) play «da fuori»: give the points to the player behind
play.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): a player who is out must play «da fuori», losing the power of his cards in the tricks and giving points to the one with the smaller total; the penalty for failing is an onoranza of five points from each of the two. PE (1787, pp. 43-44, at Sedici) calls loading the rest on another «atto poco grazioso». Whether he still follows suit is not said.

left_out.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): if both others have zero or less each pays the winner 1 game point; if one of them has a plus he neither pays nor receives and the third pays the winner 2. Torino [1846], part I, p. 34 says only who wins and who loses: «come perde chi ne ha fatto un numero minore».
left_out.why: Format gap, not silence: The format has no settle mode that reads running totals at the end of a match (FORMAT_OPEN_POINTS point 6, proposal match.payout); the payment is not played until it has.

left_out.source: [D] Dummett 1980, p. 260 (after RI): after two rounds a player whose total is above 26 cannot lose and says «Fuora» at the end of the deal; he also wins when in the last round a player has reached a sure positive total.
left_out.why: Format gap, not silence: An intention, not a checkable rule of the cards (FORMAT_OPEN_POINTS point 6): no card becomes illegal; a bot.play leaf and a hint carry it.
